subject.title: feat(diagnostics-otel): identify each instance with service.instance.id

question: Should diagnostics-otel export a canonical bounded OpenClaw runtime identity, or permanently support this operator config/environment override only for resources owned by the plugin?
rationale: The canonical issue requests OpenClaw-controlled stable identity across signals, while this PR creates a parallel public contract that standard OTel detectors override and that cannot control preloaded traces or metrics.

options.title: Use canonical runtime identity
options.body: Add a bounded service-context identity seam and export it from diagnostics-otel, while documenting that externally preloaded SDK owners configure their own resource.

options.title: Approve scoped operator override
options.body: Keep this field only after defining its actual detector precedence, preloaded limitations, complete metadata, focused tests, and live proof.

options.title: Pause pending canonical design
options.body: Keep the branch unmerged until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/93071 settles instance and version identity ownership.

recommendation.title: Use canonical runtime identity
recommendation.body: Add a bounded service-context identity seam and export it from diagnostics-otel, while documenting that externally preloaded SDK owners configure their own resource.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the clearest available owner connected to the canonical identity-source and privacy decision.
